title: Enterprise Business Rule Schema
description: Canonical representation of a business rule governing enterprise business processes.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for the business rule.

rule_name.description: Human-readable name of the business rule.

rule_description.description: Additional explanation of the business rule.

rule_statement.description: The rule expressed as a business statement.

source_reference.description: Reference to the policy, regulation, or document that defines the rule.

applies_to_activities.description: Activities governed by this business rule.

related_decisions.description: Decision points associated with this rule.

mandatory.description: Whether compliance with the rule is mandatory.

automatable.description: Whether the rule can be enforced automatically.

owner.description: Business owner responsible for the rule.

review_date.description: Scheduled review date for the rule.
